author: shaamad
text:
🔴 1. UBLOCKDOWN — URGENT, SIGNUPS CLOSE FRIDAY
📅 Competition: Saturday, Oct 24
If you want in, you MUST sign up by Friday. Spots are capped at two 6-person teams, so drop your name or DM me ASAP. Do not sit on this, once it’s full it’s full. Even if you’re doing Plinko, do this one too.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🟦 2. OPERATION: HORIZON’S EDGE — NCRC-U Collegiate CTF
📅 Oct 19 to Oct 23 | 🧑‍💻 Jeopardy-style CTF (30 hours, all virtual)
You can play in teams of 2 to 6. Each person still registers and logs in with their own account, but you work the challenges together as a team.
🗓️ The plan: we’re going to form teams and kick this off together at the Tuesday club meeting on the 20th, then keep running it as long as we can. Come through, grab a team, and let’s rack up flags.
⚠️ Register TODAY so you’re ready (orientation is the 16th, window opens the 19th). Challenge areas: network recon, web security, credentials, forensics, cryptography, reverse engineering, Windows/Linux. U.S. citizenship required.
💼 Why you should actually do this: I talked to the organizers at the career fair, and people who compete are getting interviews. That is a real opportunity, take it.
🔗 Register: https://forms.osi.apps.mil/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=D9fm-kuVEUiStgUw1vhMQ3VG59pVFWZNq32QTUjTerdUM1cxMDNHWVBOUjA3QTBFTE9OR0tWUzNGNS4u&origin=QRCode&route=shorturl

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🟢 3. CPTC — Collegiate Penetration Testing Competition
📅 Road trip to Augusta, GA — leave Fri Nov 6, compete Sat Nov 7
This is the pen testing competition. Your team acts as a real pen test firm hired to assess a client’s network, then write a professional report. One of the best things you can put on a resume if you want offensive security or consulting.
👥 Team: 6 players + 2 alternates. We currently need 3 more members and 1 more alternate.
If you want to break into pen testing, this is the one. DM me if you’re interested!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✅ Bottom line: DM me with which ones you want in on. UBlockdown is the hard deadline (Friday) so handle that first, and register for the CTF today so we can hit the ground running Tuesday.

author: Arbittrary
text:
🛶 Post-Plinko Kayaking Trip: Monday 10/19

Since Plinko is Sat and Sun in Orlando, a few of us are going kayaking Monday the 19th at King’s Landing in Apopka (about 30 min from Orlando). It’s a self-guided paddle on Rock Springs Run, crystal clear spring water, looks super chill.

⚠️ Book your spot online ahead of time. They only hold a couple kayaks for walk-ins and they sell out, so don’t plan on just showing up.

How to book:

Go here: https://www.kingslandingfl.com/daypaddlekayakrentals
Hit Book Now
Pick Monday, Oct 19 and the time slot we agree on (see below)

Prices (4 hour rental):

Single kayak: $54
Double kayak (2 people): $74
Paddleboard: $74
Canoe (3 people): $64
Locker: $10 (optional)

Double kayaks and canoes are cheaper per person if you split with someone, so pair up if you want.

Good to know:

They close at 5pm and anything booked after 1pm won’t get the full 4 hours, so we should go earlier in the day
Return shuttle isn’t included, it’s a paddle out and back to the launch

What time works for you? React below:
🌅 Morning (8:30 to 10)
☀️ Late morning (10 to 12)
🕐 Early afternoon (12 to 1)

(we should probably do the late morning one)

Drop a ✅ if you’re coming so we know headcount.
